{{< include /knowledge/includes/setup-parameters.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from dih_models.parameters import format_parameter_value
from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    COLOR_BLACK,
    COLOR_WHITE,
    add_png_metadata,
    add_watermark,
    clean_spines,
    get_figure_output_path,
    setup_chart_style,
)

setup_chart_style()

names = ["Universal Right to Trial\n(conditional)", "GiveWell modeled range\nmidpoint"]
values = [
    float(STATE_RTT_PHILANTHROPIC_COST_PER_LIFE_SAVED),
    float(GIVEWELL_COST_PER_LIFE_AVG),
]
unit = "USD/life"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

bars = ax.barh(
    names,
    values,
    color=COLOR_WHITE,
    edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK,
    linewidth=2,
    hatch=["///", ""],
)
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.invert_yaxis()
for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
    ax.text(
        value * 1.25,
        bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
        format_parameter_value(value, unit),
        va="center",
        ha="left",
        fontsize=12,
        weight="bold",
    )
ax.set_xlabel(f"{unit} (log scale, lower is better)", fontsize=11)
ax.grid(axis="x", which="both", linestyle=":", alpha=0.35)
clean_spines(ax)

fig.suptitle("Modeled Philanthropic Cost per Life Saved", fontsize=21, weight="bold", y=1.01)
fig.text(
    0.5,
    -0.03,
    "Universal Right to Trial assumes full adoption and the modeled discovery acceleration.\n"
    "The GiveWell comparison uses the midpoint of its cited modeled range, not a DALY conversion.",
    ha="center",
    va="top",
    fontsize=10,
)
add_watermark(fig)

output_path = get_figure_output_path("state-rtt-philanthropic-leverage-comparison.png")
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor=COLOR_WHITE)
add_png_metadata(
    output_path,
    title="Universal Right to Trial Modeled Philanthropic Cost per Life Saved",
    description="Conditional cost per modeled life saved compared with the midpoint of GiveWell's cited modeled range.",
)
plt.show()
```
